summary.text: Alex Andrade represents Florida House District 2, parts of Escambia and Santa Rosa counties; Andrade was elected to the Florida House in 2018 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biography, Andrade is an attorney who lives in Pensacola, was born in George Town, Grand Cayman, and moved to Florida in 1991.
Andrade earned a bachelor's degree and a law degree from the University of Florida, and has served as a Judicial Nominating Commissioner for Florida's First Judicial Circuit.
